title: localization
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch11 附录 B 定义 1-态射上的局部化（Seq_0 同构、Seq_1 为局部化）并用它描述 Gray 积与 2-笛卡尔纤维化，需 nLab 关于 (∞,1)-范畴局部化的标准定义与万有性
definition_zh: 局部化是给范畴（更一般地 $(\infty,1)$-范畴）$\mathbf{C}$ 形式地添加一族态射的逆的万有构造。给定 1-全子范畴 $\mathbf{C}'\subset\mathbf{C}$，$\mathbf{C}$ 关于 $\mathbf{C}'$ 的局部化是一对 $(\widetilde{\mathbf{C}}_{\text{can}},F_{\text{can}}:\mathbf{C}\to\widetilde{\mathbf{C}}_{\text{can}})$，使得任何把 $\mathbf{C}'$ 中 1-态射送到同构的函子 $F:\mathbf{C}\to\widetilde{\mathbf{C}}$ 都唯一地穿过 $F_{\text{can}}$。DAG 第 11 章附录 B 进一步定义 $(\infty,2)$-范畴间函子的「1-态射上的局部化」：$\Seq_0$ 为同构且 $\Seq_1$ 为局部化。
key_points: 万有性：任何把指定态射类送到同构的函子都唯一分解
反射局部化是带全忠实右伴随的特殊情形
对 $(\infty,1)$-范畴，局部化可等价地刻画为保持相应余极限的函子
DAG ch11：$F:\mathbb{S}\to\mathbb{T}$ 是 1-态射上的局部化，当且仅当 $\mathbb{S}^{\oint}\to\mathbb{T}^{\oint}$ 是局部化（命题 B.1.5）
idea_original: In mathematics, localization refers to the idea of adjoining formal inverses for some elements in an algebraic structure. In particular, the structure itself can be a category, in which case localization adjoins formal inverses to a prescribed class of morphisms. This construction is known as a category of fractions and also ambiguously as a localization of a category. An important special case of this idea is the notion of a reflective localization / left Bousfield localization, in which case the localization functor has a fully faithful right adjoint. In some texts (e.g. in Higher Topos Theory) the term “localization” (when applied to categories or (∞,1)-categories) refers specifically to reflective localizations.
references: Jacob Lurie, Higher Topos Theory, Section 5.5.4 (localization of (∞,1)-categories)
our_term: 局部化；1-态射上的局部化（localization on 1-morphisms）
used_in: vol1 ch11 §5.1（用推论 1.3.4 解释 $\sS\to\mathbf{1}\text{-}\mathbf{Cat}$ 的数据）
